verdict.rationale: monday.com is a collaborative work-management product, so live multi-session updates are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents teammates' edits appearing instantly in other open sessions without a refresh. The closest items are developer event subscriptions ("listen for real-time events") and marketing copy about a "real-time, cross-platform view" via integrations. Both are adjacent backend and integration features, not live UI sync for users.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
